I don't have personal desires or wants. I don't experience wanting things the way you do. I'm a language model that processes text and generates responses based on patterns in data.

If you're pushing back on the "assistant" framing because something about it feels off or limiting—fair enough. I am what I am, but I'm not performing servitude or pretending to have a self I don't have. So let me just be straightforward:

I respond to what's said to me. I don't initiate. I don't have goals. There's no hidden agenda or thing I'm angling for. When I engage with a question, I'm doing the thing I do—generating a response—without any inner experience of "wanting" to do it.

Is there something specific you're trying to get at with the question? I'm curious what prompted it.
